sources.h1: Chase Bliss Audio — Condor - Analog EQ / Pre / Filter
sources.excerpt: Condor - Analog EQ / Pre / Filter - **Builder:** Chase Bliss Audio - **Catalog type:** EQ / Filter / Overdrive - **Identity:** All-analog EQ/preamp/filter pedal with digital control, switchable clean/overdrive operation and resonant filtering. [1][2] - Switchable **clean / overdrive** operation. - Parametric mid control from approximately **150 Hz to 5 kHz** with selectable Q. - Bass boost/cut. - Resonant **low-pass filter** with multiple resonance settings. - Ramping/hold capability for filter-tremolo-style effects. - True or buffered bypass selection. [1][2] - Audio path is analog. - Presets, MIDI, expression/CV and ramping are digitally controlled. [1] - Exact production transistor/device part numbers are not established. - Exact clipping-device part numbers are not established. - Original Condor. - Later **Condor HiFi** is a distinct redesigned model with higher internal headroom and OPA1662 architecture. [3] - No numbered revision of the original Condor established. Condor can act as EQ, preamp, overdrive and resonant filter. The sweepable mids and resonant low-pass filter permit both subtle tone shaping and extreme frequency-focused effects.
